scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @fokusfeed/shared-types && npm run build -w @fokusfeed/domain && npm run build -w @fokusfeed/config && npm run build -w @fokusfeed/test-utils
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fokusfeed/shared-types && npm run build -w @fokusfeed/domain && npm run build -w @fokusfeed/config && npm run build -w @fokusfeed/test-utils && npm run build -w @fokusfeed/api && npm run build -w @fokusfeed/worker && npm run build -w @fokusfeed/web
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @fokusfeed/api" "npm run dev -w @fokusfeed/worker" "npm run dev -w @fokusfeed/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
